Header.secureCheckoutDesc: We secure your payment and personal information when you share or save it with us. We don't share payment details with third-party sellers. We don't sell your information to others.

BuilderCTA.description: Do not just settle for pre-built keyboards. With our state-of-the-art Ameko 3D Builder, you have the power to create a keyboard that reflects your unique style and preferences. Choose from a vast selection of components, customize layouts, and see your design come to life in real-time 3D preview.

BecomeSellerSection.subtitle: Partner with AMEKO
BecomeSellerSection.description: Join the premier marketplace for mechanical keyboard enthusiasts. Reach thousands of potential buyers and build your own brand with our professional tools today.
BecomeSellerSection.benefit1Desc: Connect directly with thousands of custom keyboard collectors and enthusiasts.
BecomeSellerSection.benefit2Desc: Access powerful analytics and management tools to scale your business.
BecomeSellerSection.quote: "AMEKO helped me scale my artisan keycap business to over 500 orders a month."

SplitPromoSection.card1Subtitle: Build your dream PC from scratch

PromoList.promo1Desc: Experience crystal clear audio with the Ngale X mic. Professional design for Streamers and Content Creators with active noise cancellation.
PromoList.promo2Desc: Experience high precision and fast response times with XTRFY Gaming mice. Ergonomic design keeps you comfortable during any activity.
PromoList.promo3Desc: Experience vivid and detailed sound with XTRFY Gaming headsets. Comfortable design and premium audio quality for every match.

PromoGridSection.card1Desc: Personalize your setup with premium PBT double-shot keycaps. Choose from hundreds of colorways and profiles.
PromoGridSection.card2Desc: Complete your battlestation with precision-stitched desk mats, wrist rests, and essential peripherals.

ShopView.title: Ameko Best Sellers
ShopView.subtitle: Our most popular products based on sales. Updated frequently.
ShopView.noProductsSubMsg: Try adjusting your filters or clearing them to see all products.
ShopView.aboutDesc: Every keyboard sold by AmekoLab is hand-assembled by our expert team using premium components sourced from trusted manufacturers. We specialize in custom mechanical keyboards for gamers, developers, and enthusiasts who demand precision.
ShopView.customizationDesc: Can't find exactly what you're looking for? Use our Custom Lab to spec out your dream keyboard — choose your layout, switch, keycap set, and more. We build it, test it, and ship it directly to you.
ShopView.warrantyDesc: All keyboards come with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Our support team is available 7 days a week to help with setup, troubleshooting, and any questions you might have.
ShopView.guideTitle: What to look for in a gaming keyboard
ShopView.guideIntro: Gaming keyboards come in all shapes, sizes, and feels, so when you’re considering yours, you’ll want to compare:
ShopView.guidePoint1: Switches and typing feel: Rubber dome, mechanical, or optical
ShopView.guidePoint2: Size and layout: Full-sized, TKL, 60%, and more
ShopView.guidePoint3: Design: Lots of RGB or artistic keycaps
ShopView.guidePoint5: Extra features: Macro keys, media controls, wrist rest
ShopView.guidePoint6: Price: From budget-friendly to premium custom builds

ShopSidebar.promoDesc: Design your own custom keyboard from scratch — your layout, your switches, your way.

CheckoutPage.policyNotice: By placing your order, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by AMK Collective's <terms>Terms of Use and Sale</terms>. You also acknowledge that your personal information will be securely collected and processed in accordance with our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> to fulfill your order and enhance your shopping experience. All financial transactions are fully encrypted and processed through secure third-party payment gateways; we do not store your full credit card details on our servers. For details regarding cancellations or refunds, please refer to our <returns>Return & Refund Policy</returns>.

terms.title: Terms of Use and Sale
terms.line1: Welcome to AMK Collective. By accessing our platform, you agree to these terms.
terms.line2: All products sold are subject to availability. Prices may change without notice.
terms.line3: We are not liable for external delays in shipping once the product is handed over to the carrier.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.line1: Your privacy is critically important to us.
privacy.line2: We only collect personal information that is necessary to process your order and deliver your items.
privacy.line3: We will never sell your personal contact information or credit card details to third parties.

returns.title: Return & Refund Policy
returns.line1: We accept returns within 14 days of receipt for most items in new condition.
returns.line2: Custom-built products may be subject to a restocking fee.
returns.line3: Refunds will be processed to the original method of payment within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.
